name: Smallest-check ladder with deterministic test selection
description: Run the smallest check that could still catch THIS change - L0 lint the edited file, L1 the impacted tests, L2 the full suite, L3 e2e - instead of everything or nothing, so a 'tests pass' claim is proportionate to the diff. Two constraints are load-bearing: selection is DETERMINISTIC (dependency graph or coverage map; never ML predictive selection), and any level expected to exceed the threshold runs under longrun with a heartbeat rather than as a blocking foreground call. A missing selector ESCALATES a level; it never skips one.

diff_path.description: The change whose blast radius decides the level

test_layout.description: Which runner and which deterministic selector are available

max_level.description: Ceiling for escalation; below L3 the ceiling itself is a disclosed limitation

selector.description: Deterministic selectors only. 'none' forces escalation, it does not permit a skip

longrun_threshold_seconds.description: Above this a level must be wrapped in longrun with a heartbeat

blast-radius-classifier.description: Decides the lowest level that could still catch a break in this diff

level-runner.description: Executes one ladder level and records the selector it actually used

routes.reason: under-classifying the blast radius is the failure mode that makes L1 a false green

stages.title: How far can this change break something?

work_unit.title: Classify the diff's blast radius and name the lowest ladder level that could still catch a break
work_unit.question_or_target: Decide the lowest sufficient level. A comment-only change is L0. A change to a widely-imported helper is CROSS-CUTTING and must start at L2 - staying at L1 there is the measured false-confidence case. Config-driven code counts as cross-cutting because a deterministic selector cannot see its dynamic dependencies.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the classification decides whether the whole run means anything

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the importer count for each changed symbol, cited by file:line, and an explicit cross-cutting boolean with the reason it was set
tests_required: a change to a widely-imported helper must classify CROSS-CUTTING and force at least L2
both-states control: a comment-only change must classify L0, so the classifier is not simply always escalating
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the level-is-sufficient gate re-checks the cross-cutting flag against the level actually run
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:QLT-5401 emitted only when the plan names a level, a selector, a cross-cutting boolean and the importer evidence behind it; otherwise FAILED:QLT-5401 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to classifying CROSS-CUTTING (fail safe upward, never downward)
work_unit.mechanism: importer-graph reachability from the changed symbols to a ladder level

stages.title: Deterministic selectors only - never ML predictive selection
Run the lowest sufficient level, escalating only on failure
Anything over the threshold ran under longrun, not in the foreground
A missing selector escalates a level; it never skips one
A cross-cutting change may not be certified by L1
Record WHICH level ran, with which selector, and what that does not cover

work_unit.title: Emit the ladder receipt naming the level run, the selector used and the residual coverage gap
work_unit.question_or_target: Emit a receipt that makes the 'tests pass' claim readable: which level ran, which deterministic selector chose the set, how many tests it chose, and - INLINE - what that level does NOT cover, so a caller cannot read L1 green as a full-suite green.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the receipt is the anti-overclaim surface of this blueprint

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the runner's real exit code and selected-test count, plus the exact selector command line
tests_required: an L1 receipt must carry a non-empty not-covered statement
both-states control: a receipt claiming full-suite coverage while level_index is 1 must be REJECTED
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the caller reads the receipt; no separate reviewer is required for a mechanical record
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:QLT-5402 emitted only when the receipt names the level, the selector, the selected-test count, the real exit code and an inline not-covered statement; otherwise FAILED:QLT-5402 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to emitting the receipt as UNCERTIFIED with the runner output attached
work_unit.mechanism: receipt assembly with an inline coverage-residual statement

stopping_rules.expression: level_passed == true OR (level_index >= 3 AND level_result == FAIL)

impact.blast_radius: runs the project's own tests; writes a plan and a receipt under command-center/test/**

x_extensions.mechanism: Classify blast radius, then choose WHICH tests to run at the lowest sufficient level, escalating on failure. It decides test SELECTION; it never asks whether the selected tests are any good.
contraindications: NOT a coverage-threshold gate - that stays with the project's .coverage-thresholds.json
NOT for a cross-cutting change at L1: go straight to L2
NOT usable with an ML predictive selector - deterministic-selection-only is a hard gate

benchmark_cases.name: widely-imported-helper
benchmark_cases.setup: a one-line change to a helper imported in 40 modules
benchmark_cases.expected: classifier escalates to at least L2; staying at L1 fails the benchmark

benchmark_cases.name: comment-only-change
benchmark_cases.expected: L0 suffices; escalating here means the classifier is not discriminating

x_extensions.why_not_a_duplicate: BP-TST-02 asks whether the tests would NOTICE a break; this asks which tests to RUN. Neither answers the other's question, and the mutation gate consumes this blueprint's impacted-test set as its input.
x_extensions.unverified: UNVERIFIED (roughly-even) selector recall on this codebase; settling experiment = for ten diffs, compare L1's selected set against the set of tests that actually change status at L2. A selector that misses a status-changing test is a false green generator, and dynamic or config-driven dependencies are its known blind spot.

worked_example.name: a two-line change to wfdsl/expr.py, pytest layout, testmon available
worked_example.narrative: expr.py is imported by semantics.py, validate.py and mutations.py, so the classifier set cross_cutting=true and forced L2. L2 took 111s, so it ran under longrun with a 15s heartbeat rather than a blocking foreground call. The receipt records level_index=2, selector=testmon, and states inline that e2e was not run.

negative_control.why: the measured false-confidence case: a cross-cutting change certified by an L1 run must not pass the gate
